SELECT class_id FROM tch_class_student WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'active' AND deleted = 0

SELECT cs.id, cs.class_id, cs.student_id, cs.join_date, cs.leave_date, cs.status, s.name AS student_name, s.avatar AS student_avatar, s.phone AS student_phone, pc.parent_phone, COALESCE(att.attendance_rate, 0) AS attendance_rate, COALESCE(att.completed_hours, 0) AS completed_hours FROM tch_class_student cs LEFT JOIN stu_student s ON s.id = cs.student_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.student_id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN c.is_primary = 1 THEN c.phone END), MAX(c.phone)) AS parent_phone FROM stu_contact c WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.student_id) pc ON pc.student_id = cs.student_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.class_id, a.student_id, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status IN ('present', 'late') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS attendance_rate, COALESCE(SUM(a.class_hours), 0) AS completed_hours FROM tch_attendance a WHERE a.deleted = 0 GROUP BY a.class_id, a.student_id) att ON att.class_id = cs.class_id AND att.student_id = cs.student_id WHERE cs.class_id = #{classId} AND cs.deleted = 0 ORDER BY CASE cs.status WHEN 'active' THEN 1 WHEN 'graduated' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, cs.join_date DESC, cs.id DESC
